issues.expected: TargetSearchingState transitions to FormationAdjustmentState on Intercepted.
issues.observed: The closed model has the exact transition and trigger.
issues.reason: The exact author-source interception transition and exact closed transition both connect TargetSearchingState to FormationAdjustmentState with the Intercepted trigger. The endpoint obligation is satisfied, so no violation candidate is emitted for it.
issues.requirement_quote: When the UAV swarm is intercepted, it transitions to the formation adjustment state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: No supplied fact rebuts the exact endpoint and trigger correspondence.
issues.title: Interception endpoint comparison

issues.basis: NL3; exact source inventory transition tr_0003 from TargetSearchingState to FormationAdjustmentState; closed transition transition:line:12 with trigger Intercepted; source trace trace:transition:tr_0003.
issues.expected: An Intercepted response from the swarm's exact current operating state to FormationAdjustmentState.
issues.observed: The only authored Intercepted consumer is TargetSearchingState -> FormationAdjustmentState; the normative source concept is not uniquely identified.
issues.reason: The target is exact and the closed model contains the Intercepted transition to FormationAdjustmentState, but the normative source is the unspecified current operating state. Because the property requires an exact endpoint pair and the source cannot be uniquely bound, the semantic endpoint comparison remains unresolved rather than being rewritten to TargetSearchingState.
issues.requirement_quote: When the UAV swarm is intercepted, it transitions to the formation adjustment state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The NL may intend TargetSearchingState as the current operating state, in which case the exact Intercepted endpoint is present and this candidate would not represent a defect.
issues.title: Interception response source is under-specified
